evidence.P1: Each plot's chain is genuinely causal rather than and-then: in 'The Reluctant One,' ev-007's implantation/silencing directly produces ev-008's 'mouthless' voice demanding a 'Yes,' and ev-015's beating pushes Morpheus to the harder jump test in ev-016 — conditions, not sequences.
evidence.P2: The four plots hold distinct stances on distinct dilemmas — 'Reluctant One' (identity as choice vs prophecy), 'Faith against the arithmetic' (self-sacrifice vs self-preservation), 'Waking to the real' (truth vs comfortable lie), 'Hunter and hunted' (freedom vs determinism) — but 'Waking to the real' drifts toward retelling by including ev-011/ev-012 as pure physical-awakening beats that advance the theme only incidentally.
evidence.P3: 'Faith against the arithmetic' is tightly membered — every cited event (ev-020 betrayal, ev-025 sacrifice, ev-032 wager, ev-044 kiss-revival) earns its place — whereas 'Waking to the real' pads the chain with ev-011 and ev-012, which are recovery/pod-ejection mechanics that belong to the awakening event but not to the truth-vs-lie argument, and it omits ev-045/ev-047 where the 'refusing to sleep again' commitment reaches its payoff.
evidence.P4: 'The Reluctant One' has full arc completeness — setup (ev-004 summons), turns (ev-016 fall, ev-032 pivot, ev-039 surge), resolution (ev-045/ev-047 self-chosen flight) — while 'Waking to the real' leaves its resolution dangling by stopping at ev-038 and never showing the cost of refusing to sleep being paid or resolved at the climax.
evidence.P5: The plots avoid rehashing despite sharing events: ev-032 and ev-039 appear in all four chains but are re-read through each plot's own lens — as identity-choice, as faith-wager, as truth-commitment, and as anti-determinism — so the same event serves four non-overlapping thematic functions rather than repeating one.

commentary: The plot layer is structurally strong on causal integrity (P1) and non-redundancy (P5): the shared events are genuinely re-purposed, not repeated, and the causation is conditional throughout. The weakness is concentrated in 'Waking to the unbearable real,' which scores lower on membership (P3) and arc (P4) because it leans on the physical-awakening events (ev-011, ev-012) that belong to a different plot and truncates before its own resolution. 'Faith against the arithmetic' is the model plot — lean, thematically unified, and complete. Perspective discipline (P2) is high overall; the four stances are cleanly separable, with only the 'Waking' plot's retelling tendency keeping it from a 5.
